summary: The study investigates the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of amorphous TiO thin films using TiCl4 and H2O precursors at 115 °C. The research focuses on characterizing the growth front through in situ real-time reflectance measurements, demonstrating the ability to optically determine the growth dynamics and surface properties of the films.
evidence: Growing amorphous TiO thin films from TiCl4 and H2O at 115 °C is used in demonstration experiments. The growth temperature was 115 °C.
